visible.author: Jim

visible.author: BrianG
visible.title: Exact Fit
visible.body: Item is exact fit, way more air flow over factory. Increased MPG
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: JoshuaC
visible.title: AFE Air Filter
visible.body: Needed a new filter, decided to get this to try it out, this coupled with the flow master muffler made my truck way more fun to drive. Feel performance on the turbo is better, more responsive and acceleration is better. Definitely worth it. Extremely easy to install also
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: AAL76
visible.title: Afe replacement filter
visible.body: Change my stock filter to an afe dry reusable filter. Time will tell if it is worth it. Hopefully get better gas mileage but it seems I lost alittle after the change.
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: MikeD2244
visible.title: Great filter
visible.body: Great filter these newer gm trucks hate the oiled filters. The dry filter is the way to go.
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (21-26 Tahoe)

visible.author: JasonBK
visible.title: Truck breathe better
visible.body: I feel like my truck breathe better. I’m averaging 21 mpg on my 2.7 Silverado. I like that fact you can clean and reuse the air filter. Highly recommend
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: PS24
visible.title: Great filter
visible.body: Added this as CAI’s aren’t legal in my state. Dropped right in and quality is good. Engine seemed to breathe easier after install.
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Manny24
visible.title: Great Mod!
visible.body: Easy to install!! Great upgrade, noticing a gain of 2mpg difference since installing, with better acceleration compared to the OEM filter.
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

visible.author: DeJean
visible.title: Easy install
visible.body: It was very easy to install the filter. I've noticed just a little deeper tone from mu exhaust.
visible.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (19-26 Silverado 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Juan C
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Doesn’t fit 2025 Ram 1500 3.0 I6
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Description said it would fit all models 02-25. Well it doesn’t. So if you have a 2025 1500 3.0 I6 SST it will not fit.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (02-18 RAM 1500, Excluding EcoDiesel & SRT10; 20-23 3.0L EcoDiesel RAM 1500)

low_same_part_other_truck.title: Gas mileage reduced significantly
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Installation was easy with good instruction. The price and quality were both up to par. Once installed, my gas mileage dropped by about 50%. I was getting about 21 mpg highway and that was reduced to 11 mpg, immediately. I removed aFe and went back to the stock Motorcraft filter and the mileage was back on track. The design could be the reason. Once you remove your stock filter, you have to cut the entire contents out of it to install the aFe inside the stock housing.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (Ford Diesel)

low_same_part_other_truck.title: Not any better
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I have used K&N in all of my vehicles for many years now. I didn't like the fact that I had to clean my MAF about once a year from the oil buildup though. I found the aFe's and thought it sounded great. I actually felt a reduction in power and zero change in MPG's. It's a 2003 BMW 330xi and the mileage indicator has proven to be exact the several times that I manually doubl-checked it. I would NOT recommend this filter to anyone. I felt I got taken for $50.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (BMW 3-Series)

low_same_part_other_truck.title: Learned the hard way nothing beats K&N
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I got this filter because I had heard that oiled filters are bad for mass air turbo cars and I thought it would flow better than K&N since its dry..........boy was I wrong !!!!!!!!!!!!! This filter hardly flows better than the stock paper !! Huge horsepower loss over the K&N.I have ordered a new K&N and would not reccomend this filter to anyone.Damn I cant wait to get that K&N back in and get the airflowing again.The turbo spools so much slower with this crappy dry filter and the car isnt making as much boost. Bottom line K&N is the best filter hands down.I wasted $50 to learn that.Take my word for it !!!
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (Volvo C70)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: OwaisD
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Poor fitment
low_same_part_other_truck.body: The air box is difficult to close after install. It fits but barely. Construction seems ok. The airbox clips seem a bit stressed after installing.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (15-23 Mustang GT, EcoBoost, V6)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: rickf150
low_same_part_other_truck.title: filter
low_same_part_other_truck.body: If you want a washable filter fine, but it has no effect on performance.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (09-26 F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.title: Installation and fit SUCKS (2008 Corvette} Stripped screws
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I've used aFe Pro-Dry flat filters and they fit tight as well but was able to fit them into place and they got me better flow and slightly increased fuel mileage. This one had a 3/8 inch or thicker lip where the stock filter has NO lip. the filter was bowed outward from the ends making it very tough to install. This resulted in the MOUNTING SCREWS only holding by a thread or two. 3 of 6 STRIPPED REQUIRING ME TO FIND LONGER ALTERNATIVE SCREWS.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (08-13 Chevrolet)

low_same_part_other_truck.title: Disappointing
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Nothing special and no real noticeable difference. Very disappointed.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (Ford Escape)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Cholelithiasis
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Okay
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Excited to try out this high flow air filter. Looks good out of the box. The rubber lip on the air filter makes putting the air box cover back on a little challenging ( thicker than stock). No biggie. I put the filter in right before a 1000 mile trip. I was disappointed to drop from 15mpg to 14.6mpg with highway driving. Was assuming/expecting that the mpg would go up.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (09-26 F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: Neverenuff818
low_same_part_other_truck.title: No mpg gains
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Installed this and drove the same route I do in the same way and it did not increase mpg any
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (09-26 F-150)

low_same_part_other_truck.author: GH
low_same_part_other_truck.title: AFE filter
low_same_part_other_truck.body: I installed this AFE filter. I didn't notice a big difference, maybe a small difference in throttle response. No sound change or feel of more power. I do like that's its washable.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW Pro DRY S Replacement Air Filter (15-23 Mustang GT, EcoBoost, V6)

low_same_part_other_truck.title: AFE Pro Dry S
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Ordered the AFE filter from AA. I believe that turbo engines spool faster with freer flow. Just my opinion. Don't believe they increase horse power or fuel mileage. AA sent me the wrong filter, but, was great in the return process. I like AA and can afford the filter, but, if you're on a budget pass on it cause it doesn't do much.
low_same_part_other_truck.product: AFE Magnum FLOW PRO DRY S Replacement Air Filter (BMW 135i/335i)
